title: Delivery
description: Deploys, backups, DLQ and circuit breakers — did the release land and is anything stuck? Home folder: Cogito — one folder holds boards and alert rules.

options.content: Deploys: verify `/health.version == GIT_SHA` after each CD run (see RUNBOOK redeploy procedure). Backups: nightly 02:00 WIB `pg_dump -Fc` → R2 `cogito-backups`, log `/var/log/cogito-backup.log`. DLQ: age-aware `dlq_fresh_depth` (24h window) — a fresh failure trips the Kuma `dlqDepth` keyword monitor. Breakers: `breaker_state{name}` 0 = closed (healthy), 1 = open.

panels.title: App version (app_info)

Shows the NoData-safe text below until the API exposes it; compare against the deployed GIT_SHA after each CD run.

panels.title: Backup heartbeat (Loki)
panels.description: Nightly-backup success lines. Generic {service} substring search on purpose — Alloy labels are only service/container/job (see config.alloy), so no backup-specific label exists to filter on. OPERATOR: pin this panel to the exact service label + line once the heartbeat reaches Loki. Success line today (host file /var/log/cogito-backup.log, infra/backup.sh): `==> Done: uploaded backups/YYYY-MM-DD.sql.gz, pruned …`. That host file is NOT shipped by Alloy today (Docker-API discovery only), so expect NoData until log shipping for it exists — until then verify with `infra/ops.sh dlq` / `ls /var/log/cogito-backup.log` per APPLY-RUNBOOK.md.
